why_the_variables: The same as the openpi environment: two launches of the openpi rows on one card were bit-identical only with deterministic GPU operations. This row samples with openpi's JAX code too; its own repeatability is not measured.

sources.what: openpi-cf: CAG's openpi fork with its two CAG servers (scripts/serve_policy_TF.py, scripts/serve_policy_VA.py) and the training config of the vision-action model (pi05_libero_unconditioned)
sources.licence: MIT (openpi: Apache-2.0; Gemma terms for the weights)

build: git clone https://github.com/yuffish/LIBERO-CF && git -C LIBERO-CF checkout 8280a500a01f7f7d45efe202cb416ca362aa8c1a
the interpreter is LIBERO-CF/openpi-cf/.venv/bin/python; openpi must be the editable install of this directory (the adapter finds the CAG server next to it, in openpi-cf/scripts/)
